integrationFindings.issue: The accessible trip-mode name matched both a wrapper and the native button.
integrationFindings.change: Select the visible native public form button. A December/two-adult query then passed.

integrationFindings.issue: The first PointSnap LAX API attempt rejected a fare-card mismatch. Expected/actual amounts were not captured on that first failure.
integrationFindings.change: Added bounded card-settle checks and structured mismatch diagnostics; the repeat matched all 63 source fares. The original cause is not established.

integrationFindings.issue: JFK frontend reconciliation exposed differences between response and displayed ordering.
integrationFindings.change: Match flight sequence, actual endpoints, local clocks and total duration instead of response position.

integrationFindings.issue: Connecting rows include layover duration before total journey duration.
integrationFindings.change: Read the journey duration between its endpoint clocks; the UA651/CM266 regression checks 464 minutes, not its 91-minute layover.

integrationFindings.issue: The collector initially found 45 rows, then could not find ordinal44. The first diagnosis of nonconsecutive identifiers was superseded by direct inspection.
integrationFindings.change: The actual page reported a filter showing44 of45 results, with UA1021 EWR–PTY absent. Reset all restored45, including UA1021. Clear filters through the official controls before collection, match physical identity, enumerate actual rows and recheck the final count.

integrationFindings.issue: One later search could not locate an expanded Business fare card.
integrationFindings.change: Live panel transitions remain unresolved. Pointer switching, keyboard-only activation, direct normal click-handler activation, explicit panel closing, atomic quote snapshots and bounded timer polling have been tested in distinct revisions. Current state diagnostics are being captured. None of the latest JFK attempts passed the frontend gate; no complete Copa claim is made.
integrationFindings.resolution: The verified implementation uses the real pointer control after scrolling and allowing the page to settle, a bounded repeat only if the requested panel is not open, and one atomic snapshot that must match the complete native fare set. All45 source rows and60 fares passed. Failed keyboard, direct-click, close-first and overly strict transition checks remain historical experiments.
